title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Shared Vehicles - SharedVehicle
description: A transport mode -- car, bike, or e-scooter -- that allows multiple users short-term, on-demand access (edintvc:SharedVehicle, subclass of edint-censo-vehiculos's Vehicle). Inherits Vehicle's full property set (licensePlateNumber, registeredOwner, vehicleType, propulsionType, environmentalBadge) plus its own vehicleState and propulsionSystemType.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SharedVehicle'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

licensePlateNumber.description: Property. Alphanumeric identifier assigned to the vehicle for registration purposes. Inherited from Vehicle (edint-censo-vehiculos).

registeredOwner.description: Relationship. The person or organisation who owns the vehicle. Inherited from Vehicle (edint-censo-vehiculos).

vehicleType.description: Property. Type of vehicle, from the VehicleType controlled vocabulary. Inherited from Vehicle (edint-censo-vehiculos).

propulsionType.description: Property. Propulsion type of the vehicle, from the VehiclePropulsionType controlled vocabulary. Inherited from Vehicle (edint-censo-vehiculos).

environmentalBadge.description: Property. Environmental badge assigned to the vehicle. Inherited from Vehicle (edint-censo-vehiculos).

vehicleState.description: Property. The shared vehicle's current state, from the VehicleState controlled vocabulary (edintvc:vehicleState).

propulsionSystemType.description: Property. Propulsion system type, from this ontology's own PropulsionSystemType controlled vocabulary (edintvc:propulsionSystemType). NOTE: this overlaps conceptually with the inherited propulsionType above (a separate, coarser 4-value scheme vs. propulsionType's 10-value one) -- a genuine redundancy between the two EDINT ontologies, not resolved here; both are kept since the source ontology declares both independently.
